description: This file defines the internal runtime class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Capture' responsible for managing capture buffers and callbacks within the Smarty templating engine. It handles opening, closing, and errors related to capture sections during template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Capture
classes.description: Handles the capture stack, buffer management, rendering callbacks, and error handling for template content capturing within Smarty.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Begins a new capture section, initializes callback registration if needed, and starts output buffering.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers start and end rendering callbacks to the template, and sets the registered flag.

methods.name: startRender
methods.description: Handles logic to prepare for rendering by adjusting the capture count and stack.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current capture section, assigns or appends buffer content to the template variables, and manages buffer cleanup.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws a SmartyException indicating a mismatch in capture blocks.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the captured buffer content by name or returns all buffers.

methods.name: endRender
methods.description: Completes a render cycle, restoring the capture count or raising an error if mismatched.
